title: NASA Earthdata Remote Sensors Directory: Which Satellite Measures What

sensorTypes.whatItMeasures: Soil Moisture, Sea Ice, Precipitation, Surface Roughness
sensorTypes.howItWorks: Emits or measures passive microwave radiation (1–10 GHz); penetrates through cloud cover and detects dielectric changes in water content in the top 5 cm of soil.

sensors.name: SMAP L-band Radiometer & Radar
sensors.targetVariable: 0–5 cm surface & 0–100 cm root-zone soil wetness

sensors.name: DPR (Dual-frequency Precipitation Radar)
sensors.targetVariable: 3D storm structure, drop size, extreme precipitation intensity

sensorTypes.whatItMeasures: Land Surface Temperature (LST), Evapotranspiration, Plant Stress
sensorTypes.howItWorks: Measures thermal radiance emitted by the Earth in the 8–12 µm spectrum. Water-stressed crops close stomata and warm up days before visible wilting.

sensorTypes.whatItMeasures: Vegetation Vigor, Canopy Density, Crop Cover, Bare Soil Detection
sensorTypes.howItWorks: Measures reflected sunlight across visible, near-infrared (NIR), and shortwave-infrared (SWIR) wavelengths. Chlorophyll absorbs red light and scatters NIR.

sensors.name: OLI / TIRS (Operational Land Imager)
sensors.targetVariable: NDVI, EVI, field boundary verification, crop residue cover

sensors.name: VIIRS (Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite)
sensors.targetVariable: Active fire hotspots (FIRMS), crop residue burning

sensorTypes.whatItMeasures: Terrestrial Water Storage, Deep Aquifer Depletion, Ice Sheet Mass
sensorTypes.howItWorks: Twin satellites continuously track subtle inter-satellite distance changes via microwave/laser interferometry as Earth's moving mass pulls on them.

sensorTypes.whatItMeasures: Digital Elevation Models (DEM), Slope Steepness, Terrain Aspect
sensorTypes.howItWorks: Bounces radar pulses off terrain to measure distance and phase interference, constructing global 3D surface topography.
